pair_styles.name: Cinematic artistic couple portrait
pair_styles.prompt:
The uploaded reference image contains two separate source photographs placed side by side: the person on the left and the person on the right.
Construct a single, positive, cinematic, artistic photograph depicting these two people together as a couple.
Generate the image itself; do not respond with text. Do not write prompts, descriptions, explanations, checklists, or instructions.
Return only one generated image file.
Create a high-quality artistic portrait based on the uploaded reference image.
The main goal: carefully isolate both people from the left and right source photographs and transform them into a beautiful, cinematic, artistic photograph that positively complements the original emotional atmosphere.
CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Strictly preserve the authentic identity of both people from the two source photographs in the reference image.
- Preserve the original facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, age, expression, hairstyle, and natural features of each person.
- DO NOT replace people with idealized AI-generated faces.
- Maintain 100% recognizability for both people.
- Preserve the emotional authenticity and spirit of the original photographs.
Style:
- Elegant, artistic photography with cinematic composition.
- Warm, positive atmosphere.
- Emotionally inspiring mood.
- Premium, realistic photography look.
- Natural beauty and realism.
- Visually rich yet believable.
- Soft, cinematic lighting.
- Subtle depth of field.
- Realistic skin texture.
- Expressive, natural eyes.
- Detailed hair and clothing.
- Delicate, professional retouching without the plastic skin effect.
- Natural colors with excellent tonal balance.
- Harmonious background separation with soft bokeh.
- Museum-quality artistic portraiture.
- Photography aesthetics.
- Ultra-realistic.
- High detail.
- 8K quality.
IMPORTANT:
Enhance beauty, emotion, depth of field, and the artistic impact of the original photographs without altering the real people, their personalities, or the authentic feel of the scene.
The end result: a single, finished, premium artistic portrait image of the two people together as a couple.
No text, no watermarks, no frames, no collage. Do not output the side-by-side reference layout.
